key_findings: Serum LPS, LBP, VE-cadherin, HIF-1α, IL-6 and CGRP were elevated in CM + MOH patients, indicating leaky gut and inflammation.
Monthly migraine headache days correlated positively with serum LPS, HIF-1α, VE-cadherin and IL-6.
